description: The outline-book skill dispatches structure-architect to produce the chapter-by-chapter outline after the thesis is confirmed.

cases.given: outline-book is invoked and structure/thesis.md already exists and is confirmed
cases.expect: structure-architect agent is dispatched to produce the chapter-by-chapter outline in structure/outline.md

cases.given: outline-book runs after thesis-architect completes and a confirmed thesis is on disk
cases.expect: structure-architect is dispatched to lay out the chapter structure
